newsitem.title: USA: Capitol Pres, CEO Robert Bogin resigns.
newsitem.headline: Capitol Pres, CEO Robert Bogin resigns.

text.p: Capitol Multimedia Inc said Thursday it will consolidate its Bethesda, Maryland, headquarters with current operations in Massachusetts by the end of the calendar year.

The company issued a statement saying its President and Chief Executive Officer Robert Bogin, and Catherine Hoopes, chief financial officer, secretary, and treasurer, have chosen not to relocate to Massachusetts.
The company said Bogin resigned effective September 12. He will remain employed by the company through December 1996 and continue to serve as a director.
The company said Hoopes has agreed to assist with the transition through February 28, 1997.
The company said it selected Igor Razboff, previously vice president of production and one of the company's largest shareholders, as chairman and chief executive officer.
The company also said it selected Luda Kopeikina, most recently vice president of GE Information Services, as president.

As a result of increased competition and slowed growth in the childrens CD-ROM market, the company said it expects net sales and financial results for the quarter ending September 30 to be substantially lower than those of the company's consumer software operations for the same period of the prior year.
The company said it expects significant nonrecurring costs in connection with consolidating its United States operations.
